page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. This instance provides 32 virtual CPUs mapped from 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the middle 50% tier across multiple standardized tests. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1573.69 and a multi-core score of 33210.62, supported by AVX-512 vector extensions and VNNI instructions. Memory bandwidth tests show a cached read speed of 1856.24 GB/sec, which drops to 111.56 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads, and a write speed of 52.56 GB/sec. In application-specific workloads, the instance demonstrates a static web serving throughput of 21.23 GB/sec and processes 30.49 million operations per second in Redis SET tests.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer a balanced hardware profile for general-purpose workloads. The lack of local NVMe storage requires reliance on network storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs for I/O-heavy applications. However, the high single-core clock speed of 3.3 GHz and robust multi-threaded decompression capabilities make this instance suitable for database operations, web serving, software compilation, and general-purpose enterprise applications that require dedicated compute resources without GPU acceleration.
